event_description: Baseline: Golkar holds minister posts in the Onward Indonesia Cabinet from its formation (Airlangga Hartarto, Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs, while Golkar general chairman; Agus Gumiwang Kartasasmita, Minister of Industry). Both were re-appointed to the same portfolios in October 2024; continuity is inferred, no dated departure was found

Baseline: Gerindra holds minister posts in the Onward Indonesia Cabinet from its formation (Prabowo Subianto, Minister of Defence, while Gerindra general chairman; Gerindra received two cabinet seats). Prabowo's end date as minister is inferred from his becoming President on 2024-10-20

Golkar holds minister posts in the Red and White Cabinet (eight minister and three deputy-minister seats at formation; Airlangga Hartarto continued as Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs). Line-up announced 2024-10-20, sworn in 2024-10-21
PKB holds minister posts in the Red and White Cabinet (Muhaimin Iskandar, PKB chair, Coordinating Minister for Community Empowerment). Line-up announced 2024-10-20, sworn in 2024-10-21
